## Contract review

Served-tier: `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`
Head-sha: `4ecc5a3cd68c917ee576fab3d2c7676d70352946`
Local-runs: none

Inputs read: card #20892 (body; comments 5914751356, 5914828402 triage, 5915701788 claim, 5916789843 os-dev-report), card #20900 (context only, not judged), PR #20915 body and file list (5 files, +272/-10, head repo objectstack-ai/objectstack, draft, no auto-merge), `git diff 33b6e8bece..4ecc5a3cd6`, and the check-runs on the head collapsed to latest-per-name. Nothing was built, run or re-run; no worktree.

### ① Derived judgments

**(a) `packages/cli/src/commands/package/publish.ts` — right.** The flag keeps `options: ['private','org','marketplace']` and loses `default: 'org'` (L333-342). The upsert body is built once, at L529-536, and `visibility` enters it only under `if (flags.visibility)`; there is exactly one `POST .../cloud/packages` in the command (L620), shared by create and re-publish, and `--submit` touches only `verBody` (L682, `submit_for_review: true`). So the key is absent in every omitted-flag path: create, re-publish and `--submit` alike. Accept set of the flag: unchanged (the same three values, or absent). What the wire loses is a key the consumer face declares optional — `CreatePackageRequestSchema.visibility` is `PackageVisibilitySchema.optional()` at `packages/spec/src/marketplace/package.zod.ts:300`, and the new pin asserts `safeParse(undefined)` on it. Today's create outcome (`org`) is preserved only by the route's default, and this repository holds NO evidence of that default: in-repo, the only texts are the row schema `PackageSchema.visibility.default('private')` (`package.zod.ts:225`, never reached by the route per the cloud seat), ADR-0006 v4 open question 2 (`private`, an open question, not a decision), and the v9 release note describing the CLI's former flag default. The `org` create default rests entirely on the cloud seat's reading on the card (body "the `org` default still applies when a package is created"; comment 5914751356 "cloud's route defaults an absent value to `org`, cloud ADR-0007 decision ②"), which triage 5914828402 and the claim 5915701788 adopted as the premise. Note the card's reach measurement exercised the PATCH path (a body carrying `org` on a stored `marketplace` row), not a create with the key absent. The PR body attributes this correctly ("as the `repo:cloud` seat reads it"); the help text, both docs rows and the changeset state it to end users as "`org` on ObjectStack Cloud" without attribution. That is an assertion about cloud this repo cannot show; it is consistent with every governing input, so it does not fail the PR, and it is carried to ③ as the one thing #20900 or a cloud measurement could later falsify.

**(b) Summary line and marketplace-draft hint — right, truthful in each case; no script-facing output exists.** `visibility` (L632-633) is the control plane's answer when `pkg.visibility` is a string, else the value the flag explicitly asked for, else undefined; the line prints `visibility ?? 'not reported by the control plane'` (L755). Echoed: prints the stored value (on create still `org` under the route default; on re-publish the true stored value, which is the fix). Not echoed with the flag passed: prints the requested value, which the upsert stored on a 200 — the same fallback the old code had. Not echoed and no flag: says so, never `undefined` (pin 6). The hint (L771) now fires on the same value, so a re-published `marketplace` package with a draft version gets it too — true and useful; a non-echoing control plane with the flag omitted gets no hint, as before. The command declares no `enableJsonFlag` (none anywhere in `packages/cli/src`), so no `--json` shape exists to change; the only visible difference is a human-facing `printKV` line on a non-echoing control plane, where `org` used to be printed from a local assumption.

**(c) `--submit` — help text true; behaviour matches it.** The file has no client-side precondition on the flag (measured by the dev, confirmed by reading: `flags.submit` is read once, at L682). The reworded text names the package's stored visibility as what must be `marketplace`, "already stored, or set with `--visibility marketplace`", plus a complete listing. With the default gone, `--submit` without the flag sends no `visibility` and `submit_for_review: true` (pin 7), so a stored `marketplace` package can be submitted without repeating the flag — exactly what the text says. That the server requires `marketplace` for a submit is a carried claim from the pre-existing text, not introduced here, and not shown in this repo (the only in-repo text is ADR-0025 L204 `pending_review → published`).

**(d) Docs — each edited sentence true; no other sentence about this flag's default is now false; v9.mdx correctly untouched.** `cli.mdx:2064` and `publish-and-preview.mdx:168` drop "(default)" and say the control plane decides: an existing package keeps its visibility (measured on the card), a new one gets the control plane's default ("`org` on ObjectStack Cloud", the cloud-seat premise from (a)). `cli.mdx:2070` (`--submit`) is the row beyond the dispatch's two: the old sentence "Needs `--visibility marketplace`" was made false by this change — before it, omitting the flag demoted the package, so the flag was effectively needed on every submit; after it, a stored `marketplace` package submits without it — and the new sentence matches the help text. Swept for other claims at the head: `content/docs/**` outside `releases/` and `references/` carries no other default claim for this flag; `packages/cli/README.md:104` lists the flag without a default; `skills/objectstack-platform/references/operations.md:106` shows `--visibility org` as an example, not a default; `content/docs/references/marketplace/package.mdx:93` "default: private" is the generated row-schema page, #20900's declaration, not this flag. `content/docs/releases/v9.mdx:231-232` "defaults to `org`" was true of the release it describes and the page is release-owned (AGENTS.md Documentation Guardrails; os-dev rule 4): leaving it was right; the wording is now inexact but not a factual error about that release, so no docs-only PR is owed.

**(e) Changeset `.changeset/20892-publish-visibility-when-asked.md` — accurate; claims nothing undelivered.** `@objectstack/cli: patch`, `Clause-②: no`, no arm; naming follows the existing issue-number-then-slug precedent in `.changeset/` (for example `20280-datetime-year-floor.md`); no tracker number or model identifier in the body. Every sentence maps to a delivered line: flag default removed, omitted flag is an omitted key, re-publish keeps the stored value (measured semantics), explicit flag unchanged, summary line and hint read the answer, `--submit` help text reworded. Its one statement about cloud is the same "(`org` on ObjectStack Cloud)" parenthetical as (a): sourced to the card's cloud seat, not to this repo. Nothing in it is undelivered.

**Tests and gates as read (not run).** `packages/cli/test/package-publish-visibility.test.ts`: 9 cases; every pass/fail assertion is about the body the CLI sent or the line it printed; the stand-in models exactly the two route facts on the card and carries a control (explicit `--visibility org` does demote) so pin 3 is not vacuous; it stubs global `fetch`, which is what `postJson` calls (L815); no cross-package path escapes (mkdtemp under tmpdir; `@objectstack/spec/marketplace` is a package import); `PackagePublish.run([...])` and the env save/restore are the sibling pins' established idiom; the file lives in `test/`, which `tsconfig.test.json` includes. The dev's ablation (A: 4 red, B: 1 red, C: 1 red, restores proven) is read from the report, not re-run.

### ② Semver level

`Clause-②: no` with `patch` is right. No accept set moves: the flag accepts the same three values or nothing; the wire drops a key the consumer face declares optional (`package.zod.ts:300`); no export, config field or spec key is removed or renamed, so no FROM → TO migration is owed and no ADR-0087 disposition applies. Removing the declared default is a behaviour change on one omitted-flag path — the re-publish path, where the old behaviour was the defect — and on ObjectStack Cloud the create outcome is unchanged. The printed `Visibility:` line is human-facing `printKV` output with no `--json` counterpart; a script that parsed it saw `org` from a local assumption and now sees the control plane's answer (on an echoing control plane, the same `org` on create) or an explicit "not reported by the control plane": that is not a public-surface narrowing under the changeset rule's `(narrowing)` arm, which is about published accept sets. A script that relied on an omitted flag RESETTING visibility to `org` on re-publish relied on the defect; the explicit flag still does it. AGENTS.md Post-Task Checklist 3: a bug fix in a released package takes `patch`; `no` with no arm is the well-formed declaration.

### ③ Boundary flags

**Dev deviations — each answered:**
1. `cli.mdx` `--submit` row edited beyond the dispatch's two rows — **accepted.** The change made that sentence false (①d); os-dev rule 3's last bullet ("本轮改动令其变假…的已发布缺陷必修") requires fixing it; the row is inside the claim's declared file and its "as far as the flag's behaviour changes" wording. Named, not silent. Right.
2. PM mechanism assumption 3 (a client-side `--submit` precondition) measured false — **accepted.** Reading confirms only help text existed; the pinned behaviour (submit without the flag sends no visibility and is not refused locally) is the true one and the reworded help text is true (①c).
3. Summary falls back to the explicitly passed value before "not reported" — **accepted.** The dispatch said "read the server's answer"; the fallback applies only when the server gives none and the user explicitly chose, never re-introduces a local default, and preserves pre-existing output on a non-echoing control plane (①b).
4. Model-free commit trailers instead of the harness's model-named one — **accepted.** Both commits (b303a0194a, 4ecc5a3cd6) end with the `Claude-Session:` and model-free `Co-authored-by` pair AGENTS.md prescribes; no model identifier in title, body, changeset or code.

**Dev out-of-scope findings — each answered:**
1. `os plugin publish` (`packages/cli/src/commands/plugin/publish.ts`) — **the seat's reading is right; class and reach are as stated.** Read at the head: L64 declares `default: 'private'`, L169 always sends `visibility: flags.visibility`, L210 the hint reads the flag. Under the card's measured route semantics, re-publishing a stored `marketplace` plugin without the flag demotes it to `private`: class (a), same family as #20892, reach a public door measured by the dev with the real CLI on the head. The dev's fold-in claim ② ("mechanical with the shape pinned here") does not hold: the CLI cannot tell create from re-publish before the upsert (the route answers `created` afterwards), so "omit the key" changes a NEW plugin's outcome from the CLI's `private` to the route's default — which is #20900's unsettled question — and preserving `private` for new plugins would need a second request or a route change, neither mechanical. os-dev rule 3 requires all four conditions for an in-place fix, so the default applies: report, do not widen. Keeping it on #20892 as the family's remaining location (rule 3: 同族发现不开单点卡) with the PR body at "Part of #20892" is the right disposition; the `Part-of PR must not also close its card` check on the re-run is green.
2. `content/docs/releases/v9.mdx:231` "defaults to `org`" — **right to leave; carrier none is acceptable** (①d).
3. The upsert answer's shape (whether `visibility` is echoed) is unmeasurable from this repo — **right, and the code is truthful either way** (①b). Not a defect; a limit of this repository's evidence.

**Reviewer's own flags:**
- The "`org` on ObjectStack Cloud" parenthetical appears in four user-facing places (flag help text, `cli.mdx:2064`, `publish-and-preview.mdx:168`, the changeset). It stands on the cloud seat's route reading on the card, which every governing comment adopted, and this repository cannot show it. If #20900 resolves toward `private`, or a cloud measurement of the create path with the key absent says otherwise, those four sentences need a follow-up docs edit; the CLI behaviour itself would not change. Not judged here beyond naming it.
- Scope: the PR's file list equals the claim's declared surface plus the one declared row; no governed surface is touched; `packages/spec` is untouched, per the claim's stated deviation from triage; head repo is the base repo; 282 changed lines.

**Gates (check-runs on the head, 35 names, latest per name, all completed at the time of writing):** the seven required contexts are green — `Lint & Repo Gates` success, `TypeScript Type Check` success (aggregator over `Type Check · source gates` / `workspace` / `debt ledger` / `consumer gates`, all success), `Test Core` success (aggregator over shards 1/6-6/6, all success), `Dogfood Regression Gate` success (shards 1/3-3/3 success), `Build Core` success, `Temporal Conformance (live PG + MySQL)` success, `Governed Surface Queue Guard` success. Also success: `Check Changeset` (its latest run 110024221966, after the body edit to "Part of #20892"), `Part-of PR must not also close its card`, `The card this PR closes must claim this branch`, `No other open PR may claim the same issue`, `No other open PR may claim the same single-writer path`, `Flag docs affected by code changes`, `Check Documentation Links`, `Build Docs`, `Dogfood Verify CLI`, `Spec property liveness`, `filter`, and the first-run `Auto Label` / `Check PR Size`.
